metadata.scenario: A retired teacher calls for the first time asking about companion care for herself. She lives alone and wants someone to check on her a few times a week. She asks about pricing and mentions she's on a fixed income so cost is a concern. The receptionist explains their most affordable options. First-time caller.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi, Margaret. My name is Betty Lou Smith. I'm calling to inquire about companion care services. Hi, Betty! I’d be happy to help you with that. What specific needs do you have in mind for companion care? Well, I live alone and I’d like someone to check on me a few times a week, you know, just for some company and help around the house. That sounds like a great way to ensure you have support. Our companion care services include social interaction, light housekeeping, and meal preparation. That sounds perfect. I’m just a little concerned about the cost since I’m on a fixed income. I completely understand. Our pricing for companion care ranges from $25 to $30 per hour. Okay, that sounds manageable. How many hours do you recommend for a few visits a week? Many of our clients choose 2-3 hours per visit, a couple of times a week, but we can tailor it to fit your needs. That makes sense. Can I schedule a caregiver to start next week? Absolutely! I can assist you with that. Do you have a preferred day and time for those visits? I think Tuesday and Friday afternoons would work best for me. Great! I’ll note that down. Would you like me to provide you with a specific caregiver? Yes, I would prefer someone consistent if possible. We can definitely arrange that for you. I’ll make sure to match you with a caregiver who’s available during those times. Thank you! I really appreciate that. You’re welcome! I’ll also need to gather some basic information from you to set up the service. Do you have a moment? Yes, I have time. What do you need from me? I'll need your full address and emergency contact information to complete the intake process. Sure, I live at 123 Maple Street, Wichita. My emergency contact is my daughter, Jessie, at 555-1234. Thank you, Betty. I’ve got that noted. I’ll also send you a welcome email with our service details. That sounds good! What else do I need to know? Just a reminder that you can always adjust your schedule as needed. We can provide additional services too, like light housekeeping or meal preparation if you're interested. I might consider that later. Thank you for being so helpful! It’s my pleasure, Betty. I’ll get everything set up and follow up with you soon. Great, I look forward to it. Have a wonderful day! You too, Betty! Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health.
